An exact positive invariant clarifies what is preserved without falsely calling it Maxwell energy; an exact output energy law exposes cancellation at an interior frequency; and the factor-two sharp mismatch between the internally stored complex field and physical output quantifies the hidden transient and the blow-up of step-margin-dependent stability constants.
